findings.title: P2: the two-zone and wood-furnace facts are re-derived from a proxy key at three seams beside their canonical predicate
findings.claim: On 40 boundary configurations, config_flow._derive_preset disagrees with ThermalParameters.from_config(...).two_zone_enabled on 20 and modbus_prefill.infer offers a flow target the pre-fill save refuses (or misses one it would accept) on 20; on 21 wood configurations topology.describe_setup's wood tank disagrees with wood_fuel.wood_furnace_on on 2; each drops to 0 when the proxy read is replaced by the canonical predicate.
findings.mechanism: ThermalParameters.from_config decides two_zone_enabled from the explicit two_zone_mode override first and the presence of any of four zone keys second; wood_fuel.wood_furnace_on decides the furnace from its flag first and a fixed inferred-key set second. Three seams decide the same fact themselves: _derive_preset (config_flow.py:1125) and modbus_prefill._plant (modbus_prefill.py:212) test bool(current.get(CONF_UPPER_FLOOR_THERMAL_MASS)), ignoring the mode key, the other three presence keys and a present-but-0.0 value; topology._wood_tank_shown (topology.py:376) re-derives the furnace from a different inferred-key set (adds valve_outlet_temp_entity, drops dhw_wood_coil_enabled). The R7-D12-01 fix (3602b6ca) moved the flow-target guard and the pre-fill save guard to the canonical predicate and left these siblings. Consequence: a two_zone_mode=off install whose zone keys survive in entry.data gets two-zone questionnaire physics written into a single-zone model (house_thermal_mass 0.267x the canonical preset's on the probe house); two_zone_mode=on without an upper-mass key gets single-zone physics (3.75x); the GCHV pre-fill offers a flow write target its own save then refuses; the setup diagram draws a wood tank the model does not run, or hides one it does.

findings.title: P8: a money figure's currency comes from the label source, never from the price feed that denominates it
findings.claim: Over 12 feed-unit x instance-currency cells the current-price sensor publishes the feed's number under hass.config.currency in all 8 cells where the price entity declares a different ISO code, with no repair issue in any; the firewood price widget is the only one of 4 currency-labelled option widgets that ignores the instance currency; and the card names two currencies on one screen for un-converted figures when card-config currency is set (price axis and what-if delta off the install's currency -- 3 counted surfaces, the axis counted as computed and as drawn; 4 before R7-D4-03, the savings table too).
findings.mechanism: inputs.normalize_price_per_kwh parses a price entity's <money>/<energy> unit for its scale and discards the money code ('The currency itself is never converted'); coordinator.currency is currency.resolve_currency(hass), i.e. hass.config.currency, and every money sensor's native_unit_of_measurement and the plan sensors' currency attribute come from it; _audit_price_units only flags an unparseable unit. So an EUR/kWh Nord Pool entity on an SEK instance publishes 0.10 as 0.10 SEK/kWh. The config flow resolves three money widgets through resolve_currency(hass) but CONF_WOOD_PRICE_SEK_M3's widget hard-codes 'SEK/m³' (config_flow.py:1645; also the simulate_plan service description in strings.json/en/sv), and wood_fuel compares that price directly with the plan's electricity prices. The card resolves currency twice: PlanSource.currency() lets card-config currency lead (price axis, what-if delta), savingsUnit() lets the savings sensor's declared unit lead (headline, savings table) -- R7-D4-03 moved only the savings table.

findings.title: I4: class roster and finding grammar have disagreeing readers (P11 on no D14 seat; intake admits schema-refused ids)
findings.claim: bugclasses.json has 16 class ids but scopes.json's D14 axis has 15, so P11 is held by no D14 seat while check_scopes.check() reports D14 ok; and audit-find.js's intake, executed on 22 boundary findings, admits 11 that finding.schema.json refuses (class ids P0/P12/P99/I0/I6/P011 and ids D14-s2-1/-001/-xx/-/-01a), 0 after it is rebuilt from the ledger and the schema's id pattern.
findings.mechanism: The class roster is written in four places: the ledger (bugclasses.json), the schema enum (held equal to the ledger by check-wave-script.mjs), the D14 axis in scopes.json (held equal to nothing), and audit-find.js's CLASS_GUESS = /^([PI][0-9]+|new)$/ plus a reportSchema whose class_guess is {type: 'string'}. P11 was added to the ledger and the schema (v6.6.12 root cause) but not to the D14 axis, and check_scopes.py proves completeness against the dimension's own axis, which is the stale list. The intake's id rule is f.id.startsWith(`${seat}-`), not the schema's ^D..(-s[0-9]+)?-[0-9]{2}$. check-wave-script.mjs's intake test uses X9 as its unknown class, a case both readers already agree on.

findings.title: P3: 22 quantities are read through a positive floor at one seam and raw at a sibling; no check enumerates them
findings.claim: At the baseline the package holds 22 quantity groups (6 with a raw read used as a divisor, 1 a store capacity: dhw_tank_thermal_mass) that are read through max(Q, c) at one site and raw, or through a different floor, at another. Nothing in the gate enumerates them: the only barrier is tests/features.py's seven arms pinning the eight seams ab71960d repaired, so a new floor elsewhere is not caught.
findings.mechanism: A floor added as a local divide-by-zero guard changes the value one formula reads while its sibling formulas read the raw quantity, so the two formulas disagree whenever Q is below c (R7 D2-01: the buffer's stored energy became C/0.01 of the delivered heat). At the baseline every listed floor is at or below the config schema's minimum for that quantity (spot-checked: cop_nominal floor 1.0 vs schema 1.5; max_electrical_power 0.1 vs 1 kW; DHW 50 L means C=0.058 vs a 1e-6 floor; frsi 0.3 vs 0.3; slab_heat_transfer 1e-6 vs 0.02; peaks_averaged 1 vs 1). So no seam is reachable from the UI today, and that is why this is low.

findings.title: P4: both multi-start seams stop at non-stationary points; 12 of 30 seam calls ship >0.1 % above reachable
findings.claim: Across 24 golden-built cells (1/2-zone x DHW on/off x 6 price profiles, winter_cold), 12 of 30 production _multi_start_minimize calls return an objective more than 0.1 % above what the same routine reaches from its own candidates at a tight stop (max 0.52 %), and 12 of 30 are above a dense seed ladder's result (max 0.89 %). The gap survives the flat-price null in 3 of 4 topologies, so it is the ftol=1e-6 stop on a rugged objective, not a price-bracketing miss.
findings.mechanism: L-BFGS-B at ftol 1e-6 with FD gradients (eps 1e-4) halts at non-stationary points: on two|nodhw|winter_typical the five production candidates refine to 77.72 to 79.16 at the shipped tolerance, and the same five reach 77.43 at ftol 1e-12 (with ABNORMAL line-search exits). The shipped plan is decided by which start happens to stop lowest. Removing the round-7 deep seed re-finds R7 D0-01 exactly (77.884228, the round-7 number).

findings.title: P5: sysid adoption gate keys on the UA half-width, which barely moves while unmodelled free heat biases UA to -21 %
findings.claim: Driving the production experiment on declared plants whose true free heat differs from the declared internal gains, sysid:adoption_decision admits 3 fits whose true UA error exceeds the gate's own +-10 % bar (worst -21.43 %, blended heat-loss scale moved -7.97 %). The gated half-width moves only 0.0531 -> 0.0685 as the error goes 0 -> -21 %, and falls (0.0531 -> 0.0491) as the error rises to +8 % on the other side.
findings.mechanism: identify_slab ridges G toward gains_prior_kw, which production sets to the declared internal_gains (coordinator SysIdConfig construction). Free heat the house has but the declaration lacks is absorbed 1:1 by the UA column. The #1459 prior term adds a constant in quadrature to the profile half-width; it prices how strong the prior is, not how far the data sit from it. So the gated quantity is almost independent of the bias. Pre-#1459 the same sweep admits 5 over the bar at hw ~1e-4 (the round-7 D7-01 signature) with a -20.98 % blended shift. The fix cut the weight but kept the phenomenon.
